title: SI change indication and PWS notification

entities.name: Short Message
entities.description: Message transmitted with P-RNTI over DCI used to indicate SI modifications and PWS notifications.

entities.name: SI change indication
entities.description: Procedure where UE monitors for system information modifications via Short Message.

entities.name: PWS notification
entities.description: Procedure where UE monitors for Public Warning System notifications via Short Message.

entities.name: etwsAndCmasIndication bit
entities.description: Bit in Short Message indicating ETWS or CMAS notification.

entities.name: systemInfoModification bit
entities.description: Bit in Short Message indicating system information modification.

entities.name: systemInfoModification-eDRX bit
entities.description: Bit in Short Message indicating system information modification for eDRX configured UEs.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC idle state where UE monitors paging occasions.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC inactive state where UE monitors paging occasions.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC connected state where UE may monitor paging occasions.

entities.name: T319a
entities.description: Timer that affects monitoring behavior in RRC_INACTIVE state.

entities.name: eDRX cycle longer than modification period
entities.description: Condition where UE uses extended DRX cycle longer than modification period.

entities.name: Monitor paging occasions
entities.description: UE behavior to monitor paging occasions for Short Message reception.

relations.description: Short Message contains etwsAndCmasIndication bit for PWS notifications.
Short Message contains systemInfoModification bit for SI changes.
Short Message contains systemInfoModification-eDRX bit for eDRX configured UEs.
SI change indication monitoring requires UE to be in RRC_IDLE state.
SI change indication monitoring requires UE to be in RRC_INACTIVE state.
PWS notification monitoring requires UE to be in RRC_IDLE state.
PWS notification monitoring requires UE to be in RRC_INACTIVE state.
Monitoring paging occasions requires UE to be in RRC_IDLE state.
Monitoring paging occasions requires UE to be in RRC_INACTIVE state.
Monitoring paging occasions may occur in RRC_CONNECTED state under certain conditions.
eDRX cycle longer than modification period condition guards systemInfoModification-eDRX bit usage.
T319a timer running condition affects monitoring behavior in RRC_INACTIVE state.
